report.summary: P-D003 (67F, Original Medicare, no transport benefit) needs utilities and transport support. She screens positive for a transportation barrier (rides with others/cab, never licensed) and lives in a high no-vehicle-share tract (37.5%) with elevated utility-shutoff prevalence (21.5%), though no imminent shutoff is reported. Best transport option: Senior Shuttle West (free, age 60+, weekdays 7am-5pm) — appears eligible by age. Paratransit certification is a slower fallback (up to 21 days); Medicaid Ride Line does not apply (Medicare). For utilities: Shutoff Prevention Clinic (walk-in Tuesdays) if a disconnection notice arises; Neighborhood Energy Help (income-based, Mon/Wed in-person) pending income verification; Lakeside Energy Assistance requires a case number to generate a referral link.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Call to schedule free rides to medical appointments; patient is 67 (age 60+ eligible), weekdays 7 AM-5 PM.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit)
options.how_to_access: Apply by phone for certification; decisions take up to 21 days. Slower fallback for ongoing medical rides.

options.name: Shutoff Prevention Clinic
options.how_to_access: Walk-in help with disconnection notices, Tuesdays. Use if a shutoff notice arises.

options.name: Neighborhood Energy Help
options.how_to_access: Income-based help with gas and electric bills; apply in person Mon/Wed. Income eligibility not yet verified.

options.name: Lakeside Energy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Referral tracking link requires a case/record number to fill in; request a case number from clinic staff.
